messages.subject: Harbor - internal: directors' duties + intercreditor watchpoints
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Two things before the board call:
1. The directors' duties note is finalised - I'll send to the board. Key message is the Sequana shift to creditors' interests and keeping the trading decision minuted.
2. On the intercreditor, I want to make sure the family's £5m sits firmly behind both the super-senior and senior, with PIK only and a turnover trust. Elena's drafting - I'll review before it goes to Pemberton Rowe.

James

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
